source.note: Search summary (results: Wikipedia, breckenridge.com "Breck Mountain Information & Stats", OnTheSnow, GoBreck): 2,908 skiable acres; trails 187 (14% beginner / 31% intermediate / 19% advanced / 36% expert); 20 aerial lifts (1 gondola, 5 detachable six-seat, 8 detachable quad, 1 fixed-grip quad, 1 fixed-grip triple, 4 fixed-grip double chairs) plus 15 surface lifts (4 bar lifts, 1 tow rope, 10 magic carpets; carpets counted as "other"). Total 35 is the sum. Season of the figures not stated. Official breckenridge.com homepage (2026-10-03) confirms "Lifts: 35 · Runs: 187 · Elevation: Up to 12,998 feet" and "nearly 3,000 acres".

Slopeside lodging along the Peak 8 and Peak 9 bases. High base elevation (about 9,600 ft) — altitude is a real consideration for visitors from sea level

character: A high-altitude resort spread across Peaks 6 to 10 of the Tenmile Range directly above the historic mining town of Breckenridge. It pairs plenty of groomed intermediate cruising lower down with high alpine bowls, and its base elevation of about 9,600 ft is among the highest in North America.
learning: Reference note: much of the easiest terrain is on lower Peak 9 and around the Peak 8 base, with lessons through the resort ski and ride school. Confirm where first-timers start, carpets and lesson products.

transfers.name: Epic Mountain Express (shared airport shuttle)
transfers.notes: Reference, confirm: Vail Resorts' shared-ride shuttle (formerly branded Colorado Mountain Express) has run from DEN and EGE to Vail and Summit County. 2026-27 schedules and fares are unconfirmed.

transfers.name: Summit Stage (county bus)
transfers.notes: Reference, confirm: the free Summit County bus has linked Frisco, Breckenridge, Copper Mountain and other Summit County towns. 2026-27 routes and schedules are unconfirmed.

transfers.name: Breckenridge Free Ride buses and BreckConnect Gondola
transfers.notes: Reference, confirm: the town's free buses and the free gondola from town lots to the Peak 7 and Peak 8 bases. 2026-27 schedules are unconfirmed.

transfers.name: Bustang (CDOT intercity bus, I-70 West line)
transfers.notes: Reference, confirm: CDOT's intercity coach has run along I-70 from Denver with stops including Frisco and Vail. Confirm 2026-27 stops, schedule and fares.
